decisions.reason: This is the sole short-output first-pass observation, while its observed throughput is slightly above same-prompt H0+B-Q and H3 is a candidate balanced speed/memory configuration. Repeat to determine whether the short completion itself is reproducible and to separate observed-throughput from strict-long-form interpretation.

H1b+B-B is a clean block-62 local maximum versus H1a/H1c on P08 but did not receive an objective repeat. This repeat is useful for deciding whether the bounded block-localization follow-up is warranted.
